+
+| Protocol | Mean query success | Mean longer-delay success |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Scalar | 16.7% | 20.8% |
+| Scalar-matched | 20.8% | 20.8% |
+| Vector | 20.8% | 20.8% |

+| Modes | 16.7% | 20.8% |
+| Wave | 16.7% | 20.8% |
+
+These are means over three paired training seeds, with 24 query episodes per seed and condition. Wave equaled scalar on every seed; it was 0.0417 below four simpler communication controls on the mean success metric. Its seed-level bootstrap interval versus scalar is [0,0] because all three observed paired differences are zero; that degenerate small-sample interval is not evidence of equivalence in the population. Zero gain, packet erasure, shuffled phases and randomized phases all left wave success unchanged in this pilot. Training loss decreased for all 21 models; decreasing loss did not establish useful wave communication.
+
+The raw run preserves its original source snapshot. Subsequent changes harden rejected-checkpoint loading and update documentation; they do not change the successful forward/training path. Final-code replay is audited separately in `reports/training-audit.json`.

+@pytest.mark.parametrize('assign', [False, True])
+def test_failed_checkpoint_load_preserves_tensors_and_authoritative_topology(assign):
+    _, Model = api()
+    source = Model(small(), 'wave', 11)
+    restored = Model(small(), 'wave', 21)
+    before = restored.state_digest()
+    topology = restored.topology
+    malformed = {name: value.clone() for name, value in source.state_dict().items()}
+    malformed['output_decoder.weight'] = malformed['output_decoder.weight'][:1]
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
+        restored.load_state_dict(malformed, assign=assign)
+    assert restored.state_digest() == before
+    assert restored.topology is topology
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('corruption', ['missing', 'unexpected', 'non_tensor', 'dtype'])
+def test_checkpoint_preflight_rejects_malformed_mapping_without_mutation(corruption):
+    _, Model = api()
+    source = Model(small(), 'wave', 11)
+    restored = Model(small(), 'wave', 21)
+    before = restored.state_digest()
+    malformed = {name: value.clone() for name, value in source.state_dict().items()}
+    if corruption == 'missing':
+        del malformed['output_decoder.weight']
+    elif corruption == 'unexpected':
+        malformed['unknown_tensor'] = torch.ones(1)
+    elif corruption == 'non_tensor':
+        malformed['output_decoder.weight'] = 'invalid'
+    else:
+        malformed['output_decoder.weight'] = malformed['output_decoder.weight'].double()
+    with pytest.raises((RuntimeError, TypeError)):
+        restored.load_state_dict(malformed)
+    assert restored.state_digest() == before

+

method: Read existing JSON and CPU weights_only checkpoints; reconstruct same-seed initialization; exact current-runtime checkpoint replay. No retraining or new evaluation conditions.
source_difference_interpretation: Saved snapshot generated the pilot. Current runtime differs only in rejected-checkpoint-load preflight/rollback; regression tests and documentation were subsequently updated. Forward/training/init numerical paths remain unchanged in observed diff.

scalar_matched: lower paired confidence bound is not positive

attention: lower paired confidence bound is not positive

scientific_findings: No demonstrated wave performance advantage; wave and scalar mean success are 1/6 (16.67%). Four auxiliary controls average 5/24 (20.83%).
Three independent training seeds are exploratory and below the predeclared 30-seed confirmation threshold.
All auxiliary residual gains moved from exact zero and all message encoder/decoder weights changed. Parameter changes establish optimization activity, not a useful communication advantage.

Wave interventions changed 75/288 paired action sequences, exclusively during movement-locked waiting ticks in seed47. No movement-enabled actions, final positions, success outcomes or mean returns changed across the recorded interventions. Optimized communication did not affect evaluated task behavior.
Unused protocol-specific parameter tensors remain unchanged outside their relevant arms, consistent with the declared routing computations.
All seven arms use paired support/query seeds, 40 updates, 320 support episodes and 1600 executed support steps per seed; support, query and retention seed IDs are disjoint.
Distinct query seeds resample the same six fixed direction goals; there is no evidence of transfer to held-out geometries or broad navigation competence.
Longer-delay retention is a proxy, not a sequential catastrophic-forgetting experiment.
Examples are matched, but scalar and auxiliary parameter/payload budgets differ and measured compute equivalence is not established.
Training and this replay use clean tensor transport. Reference impairment tests do not establish trained robustness to those impairments.
An unsigned receipt detects changed artifacts but is not cryptographic proof of authorship or authenticity.
